title: euphrasia collina subsp. diemenica
intro: Euphrasia collina subsp. diemenica, commonly known as the Tasmanian eyebright, is a plant species native to Tasmania. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat eye and respiratory issues, such as conjunctivitis and bronchitis. The health benefits of Euphrasia collina subsp. diemenica include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and protect the eyes and respiratory system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate mucous secretion, reduce inflammation, and relieve spasms, while its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, contribute to its medicinal properties.
